name: Emissary-class shuttle
description: The Emissary-class shuttle was a diplomatic shuttle type used after the Seventh Battle of Ruusan. Emissary-class shuttles were hyperdrive-equipped shuttles used by the Galactic Republic. They were referred to as serviceable, but far from luxurious, like the Theta-class shuttle. The New Dawn, a shuttle owned by Chancellor Tarsus Valorum, was an Emissary-class shuttle.
